## Change

Describe the problem and resulting behavior. Name the module scope and task owner.

## Shared interfaces

List shared-file/contract changes, affected owners, and coordination or merge order. Write “none” if not applicable. Note migrations and generated artifacts when relevant.

## Verification

List commands actually run and their results, including failures and checks not run. For generation changes, inspect processing-job/analysis status as well as HTTP responses. Link the committed handoff when applicable.

## Review

- [ ] Sample/provider limitations and remaining work are stated accurately.
- [ ] Reference frames, storyboard seconds, revisions and approval gates are preserved where affected.
- [ ] Intended files only; no secrets, local media or runtime data.
- [ ] Current `main` and PR head were checked; required checks/reviews are satisfied before merge.
